# Refocus

> Virtual co-working, focus rooms, and body doubling for deep work — timed focus sessions with an accountability partner.

Refocus pairs you with another person for 25, 50, or 75-minute focus sessions. Share your goal, work side by side with synced timers, and check in at the end. Built for students, remote workers, ADHD-friendly workflows, and anyone who struggles to show up alone.
